items.title: Is A Medicare Delay The Biggest Risk For DexCom Stock?
items.summary: DexCom (DXCM) owners have one dated question left for 2026: will Medicare agree to pay for glucose monitors for people with type 2 diabetes who are not on insulin? DexCom said on its call after Q3 results that it expects CMS to announce that coverage decision this year, with DexCom's current plan assuming coverage takes effect in the middle of 2027. items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks That Don’t Need a Booming Economy to Keep Paying
items.summary: A heart device maker, a bomber builder, and a garbage hauler all raised their payouts in 2020, when the economy stalled. Their yields look small, but the cash behind them tells a bigger story about what recessions can't touch.
